sql: SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(prc IS NOT NULL) prc_nn, SUM(prc_usd IS NOT NULL) prcusd_nn, MIN(prc), MAX(prc), MIN(prc_usd), MAX(prc_usd) FROM items_g2
SELECT rtg, COUNT(*) c, MIN(LENGTH(body)) min_len, MAX(LENGTH(body)) max_len FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY rtg ORDER BY rtg

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg = 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_1star,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.rtg = 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_1star,
  COUNT(*) AS n_total
FROM fdbk_g2 f
JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
WHERE LENGTH(f.body) > 500
  AND i.prc_usd IS NOT NULL
  AND i.prc_usd <= 40

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fdbk_g2 f LEFT JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE i.ref_id IS NULL) AS unmatched_reviews,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE (prc IS NULL) != (prc_usd IS NULL)) AS price_field_mismatch,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL AND ABS(prc - prc_usd*100) > 0.01) AS price_inconsistent,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fdbk_g2 f JOIN items_g2 i ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE LENGTH(f.body) > 500 AND i.prc_usd <= 40) AS n_total_no_null_filter
